canonical_form.title: false_verification_claim hook — implement audit-verification-claims
canonical_form.description: hooks.json declares false_verification_claim (turn.pre_emit, immediate): detect verification claims without execution evidence in current session (execution_output, commit_sha, test_receipt). Downgrade unsupported claims to unverified. No backing tool file exists. Behavioral contract: receipts beat memory. GNB authority semantics: no claimed verification without a receipt anchor.
